content: Yooseefe naa Minaasey yelida Maakire naa Gala7aade zarkketa kaaleththiza halaqati Musekkonne Isra7eele asaa kaaleththizaytakko shiiqidi,
«Neni hanno biittayo Isra7eele derezas saaman gishana mala GODAY nena nu godaza azazides; hessaththoka nu isha Xilofaade gisha iza macca naytas immana mala nena azazides.

Gido attiin istti geliza azinati hara qommofe gidikko istta gisha gadey nu zarkketa xinxxofe qanxxettidi he istti gelida azinata zarkketas gujettiza gishshas nu zarkketa xinxxozi kase ekettoyssafe pace gidees.
Wozzo layththay gakkiza wode istta gishazi istti gelida zarkkes gujettees; hessa gishshas istta xinxxoy nu zarkketa xinxxo pacinchchees» gida.
Hessafe guye Musey GODAY izas yootida mala Isra7eele asaas, «Minaase zarkketi gidayssi wurikka likke.
Hessa gishshas GODAY Xilofaade macca nayti ba zarkketa giddofe ba dosidaade gelanaas dandayeettes.
Hessa malan Isra7eele asaa xinxxoy issi zarkkefe hara zarkken aadhdhofo; Isra7eele asay kase ba aawatappe laattida biitta minththi oykko.
Isra7eele asaa zarkketa giddon ba aawa gade laattida maccassi oonikka ba qommo gelanaas bessees; hessa malan Isra7eele asay ubbay ba aawata xinxxo naaganaas dandayees.
Hessa gishshas gadezi issi zarkke kusheppe hara zarkke kushen aadhdhanaas dandayenna; wurikka ba zarkken zarkken ba biitta oykki naago» gides.
Xilofaade macca nayti GODAY Muse azazida mala ooththida.
Xilofaade macca nayti Mahilo, Tirxxo, Hogilo, Milkko, No7o; heytantti ba aawa ishata nayta gelida.
Yooseefe naa Minaase zarkketa giddon azina gelida; he istta biittay istta aawata zarkke sunththan minni attides.
Isra7eele asay Iyarkko ginara Yordaanoose shaafappe he pinththan Mo7aabe demban dishin GODAY Muse baggara isttas immida wogatinne azazoti haytantta.
